spans.s: ईर् (I) vt. 1P (pp. ईरित) To go, to shake.
ईर् (II) vt. 2Ā (pp. ईर्ण) To go, to move.With उद्-, to rise.

ईर् (III) vt. 10U (pp. ईरित) 1. To move; 2. to throw; 3. to pronounce, इतीरयित्वा विरचय्य वाङ्मयम् Na.i.184, Kir.i.26.With उद्-, 1. to utter, to tell, R.ii.9; 2. To put forth, कुसुमं यदन्नोकोऽवमुदीरयिष्यति R.viii.62; 3. to throw up, R.vi.18.With प्र-, to propel, to send, R.iv.24.With सम्-, 1. to move, to shake; 2. to utter.With समुत्-, to utter.
